summary: Reproduced the config-only sglang serve failure in the prepared checkout. Backend selection inspected raw argv before ServerArgs merged --config, so it rejected a YAML-provided model-path. The fix reuses ConfigArgumentMerger during best-effort backend detection while preserving explicit CLI precedence.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-bffb99b35b3b/venv/bin/python -c 'from sglang.cli.serve import serve; serve(None, ["--config", "/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-bffb99b35b3b/issue-36105.yaml"])' (before fix)
tests.what_was_measured: The actual prepared serve implementation rejected the config before parsing it with 'Error: --model-path is required'; raw traceback is in raw/baseline-serve-config.log.
17 CLI/backend unit tests passed, including config-only dispatch and independent explicit-precedence, model-alias, malformed-config, and missing-config cases.

The actual serve backend selection and ServerArgs parser completed, and the launch boundary received model_path=/tmp/issue-36105-nonexistent-model from YAML. Raw output is in raw/fixed-serve-config.log.

remaining_limitations: No full model was launched and no inference request was made; the post-fix command intentionally used a nonexistent local model to prove that execution advanced past the reported premature CLI rejection.
No GPU execution was performed because the changed and tested path runs before engine or device initialization.
The two related upstream candidate fixes (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36107 and https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36168) were open and unmerged when inspected.
